HANTEX • ENERGY MANAGEMENTHybrid data: local InfluxDB every second, InfluxDB Cloud for all other devices.

Data connections (hybrid)

The 12 controllers (Gen 1–8, Bus Coupler 1–2, KE Mains, PV Solar) and the generation trends come from the local InfluxDB every second on site, or from the copy the site logger writes to InfluxDB Cloud when you are away. All other meters come from InfluxDB Cloud. Setpoint changes always need the local database. Settings are saved only in this browser.

Used only when the controllers come from the cloud. The site logger writes them every 5 seconds. Each refresh is one billed cloud query: 10 s is about 8,600 queries per day while the dashboard is open and visible.

LOCAL INFLUXDB · 12 CONTROLLERS · EVERY 1 SECOND (SITE ONLY)

INFLUXDB CLOUD · ALL OTHER METERS + CONTROLLER COPY

The cloud logger writes every 15 minutes, so 60 seconds is plenty. Minimum 15 seconds; 0 turns cloud auto refresh off. The local refresh is fixed at 1 second.

SETPOINT COMMANDS

Gen 1 setpoint requests are written to this bucket on the local InfluxDB and picked up by the site logger. The local token needs write access to it.

Total supplySolar PVGas gensetsGrid import
SourceMinimumAveragePeakIntervals available

Total supply is gas + solar + grid import, used as a plant-load estimate; BESS is not included. Exported and negative power are excluded from these totals. All eight generator readings are required for a gas total, and all ten source readings for a supply total. Gaps indicate missing data; recorded zero output remains zero. Averages and peaks use available completed intervals, not instantaneous readings. CSV readings retain signed source values; missing values are blank. This report is a snapshot—use Refresh report to update.
